headline: Japanese Companies' Dividends Hit Record 23 Trillion Yen; 'Warm Breeze' Even for Shrinking Household Budgets
summary: Total dividends paid by Japanese listed companies are expected to reach a record 23 trillion yen. AI and semiconductor-related firms and trading companies lead the increase.
why: Dividend payouts by listed companies are a key source of shareholder returns and influence Japanese equity income and household savings.
